The '''Mil-StarIV engine''' was a model of [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]] manufactured by [[Tion Mil/Sci Industries/Legends|Tion Mil/Sci Industries]]. [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]] [[Pursuer-class enforcement ship|''Pursuer''-class enforcement ship]] was equipped with dual Mil-StarIV engines assisted by three [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[x41 maneuvering thruster]]s.<ref name="EGVV" />
